abort.no_devices_found:
No BUSY Bar devices found.
Make sure to check the following:
- BUSY Bar is charged and powered on
- If you want to use Wi-Fi, go to SETTINGS > Wi-Fi and check whether BUSY Bar is connected to the same network than the machine running Home Assistant.
- If you want to use USB, check whether BUSY Bar is connected to the machine running Home Assistant.

notify.name: Show a notification
notify.description: Shows a message on the bar's front display, laid out to fit, with an optional icon and sound.

line_1.name: Line 1
line_1.description: The first, or only, line of text.

line_2.name: Line 2
line_2.description: A second line. Giving it uses the two-line layout.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: A built-in icon, drawn at the left edge.

sound.name: Sound
sound.description: A built-in sound, played with the notification.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the notification stays on screen.

font.name: Font
font.description: Text font. The two largest only fit a single line.

background_color.name: Background colour
background_color.description: Fills the panel behind the text. Needs API 24.3.0.

next_phase.name: Skip to the next phase
next_phase.description: Moves an interval session on: work becomes rest, rest becomes the next work. After the last interval the session ends.

set_theme.name: Set the theme
set_theme.description: Changes the theme. Without a card, the running session changes and reverts when it ends; with one, that card's own theme changes for good.

theme.name: Theme
theme.description: A theme this bar has. The bar's own list is on its theme entities; a name it does not have is refused rather than stored.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Change this mode's own theme instead of the running session's.

play_sound.name: Play a sound
play_sound.description: Plays one of the bar's built-in sounds.

clear.name: Clear the display
clear.description: Removes what this integration drew, leaving the bar's own screen. Notifications with a duration disappear on their own.

start_session.name: Start a session
start_session.description: Starts a session on one of the bar's two modes. A kind and a duration change that mode's timer first, which the bar and the BUSY app will both show - a session cannot carry a length of its own.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Which of the bar's two modes to start, BUSY or CUSTOM.

theme.name: Theme
theme.description: Show this session in a different theme. The mode keeps its own, which the bar returns to when the session ends.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Minutes of work, or the whole countdown for a countdown mode. Saved to the mode, since a session cannot have a length of its own. The bar ignores anything under five minutes.

rest.name: Rest
rest.description: Minutes of rest between work phases. Saved to the mode, and also at least five minutes.

cycles.name: Cycles
cycles.description: How many work phases the session runs. Saved to the mode.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Off, Simple or Pomodoro - the words the BUSY app uses. Given, the mode's timer becomes that kind before the session starts, so a simple timer for forty minutes is one action rather than three steps.

stop_session.name: End the session
stop_session.description: Ends the session, leaving nothing running. Not the same as the selector's off position, which is the bar's do-not-disturb.

pause_session.name: Pause the session
pause_session.description: Pauses the running session where it is.
